statement: For every unramified dyadic DVR A and unit u, both localized and formal normal nodes xy=2^n u have polynomial induction iff n=1 iff regularity; every n≥2 has a nonzero generic C2 kernel
notes: No perfectness, henselianity or finite-residue assumption. Rank2 witness for n≥3 and rank6 for n=2. Every integer-localized K0=Z for polynomial nodes only; formal generic K0 is not asserted. This is kernel nonvanishing, not a computation of the full kernel.
